name: get_driver_profile
description: Look up a commercial driver's compliance record: CDL status and expiry, medical certificate, drug/alcohol test status, hours-of-service (HOS) violations, and vehicle inspection result. Use this to show the underlying evidence when a user asks for details about a driver.

known_driver_ids.description: Populated only when the driver was not found

name: evaluate_driver_fitness
description: Deterministic DOT compliance rules engine. ALWAYS use this tool to decide whether a driver is fit to drive — never decide fitness yourself. Evaluates CDL validity/expiry, medical certificate, drug/alcohol testing, HOS violations, and vehicle inspection. Returns status FIT, NEEDS_REVIEW, or UNFIT_TO_DRIVE with the specific violations and review reasons.

violations.description: Hard DOT violations that make the driver unfit

review_reasons.description: Missing or unclear records requiring human review

name: notify_fleet_owner
description: Send a compliance alert to the fleet owner and safety manager. Only call this tool when evaluate_driver_fitness returned UNFIT_TO_DRIVE or NEEDS_REVIEW. Include the driver id, status, and specific violations or review reasons in the message.

message.description: Alert text with driver id, status, and reasons
